name: @jsamuel1/xero-mcp-server
description: A MCP server for Xero (fork of @xeroapi/xero-mcp-server with OAuth2 Web App support)

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/index.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!/usr/bin/env node'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);fs.chmodSync(f,'755');"

author: Xero (https://xero.com)
